title: Rezoning to allow housing at 289 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves a zoning map amendment changing an industrial district to mixed-use and residential districts at 289 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. It would facilitate an 18-story building with 278 apartments, including 56 to 83 permanently income-restricted units, plus about 29,300 square feet of ground floor commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 and approved the plan on October 8, 2026.
